fields.label: Patient
fields.description: Real link to this platform's own Patient doctype -- resolved from the mobile app's `uhis_patient_id` at booking time when it validly resolves. Distinct from shukhee_patient_id (Shukhee's own vendor-side patient identity). Null when the app didn't send a valid id (soft-degrade, never blocks booking).

fields.label: Shukhee Patient ID
fields.description: Shukhee-side patient id (resolved/created server-side from contact_number).

fields.label: Geography Node
fields.description: Denormalized from patient's household at insert time (see shukhee_integration.hooks_impl.set_call_logs_geography_node) -- drives spice_next_core.api.sync.pull's catchment filter. Never client-supplied.

fields.label: Encounter ID
fields.description: Optional identifier supplied by the app; no FK, carried through for later correlation to the visit.

fields.label: Status
fields.options:
pending
confirmed
accepted
completed
rejected
cancelled
on-hold

fields.label: Call URL
fields.description: Includes a live Shukhee access token in the query string -- can exceed Data's 140-char limit.

fields.label: Appointment Status
fields.description: From Shukhee's nested `appointment.status` (Title Case) -- distinct from the `status` field above (lowercase, the outer request-level status). Gates when clients show the live call view vs. a prescription-in-progress wait.

fields.label: Doctor Name
fields.description: From Shukhee's emergency-request `doctor.name` -- populated once Shukhee assigns a doctor, may be blank before then.

fields.label: Doctor Facility
fields.description: From Shukhee's `doctor.working_at` -- a raw facility code (e.g. "DMC"), not a formatted name.

fields.label: Medical Documents
fields.description: Documents the SK photographed/uploaded before booking (if any), each also sent to Shukhee's own /ssk/medical-document/upload with this same type. Hidden -- rendered as a gallery by medias_gallery/call_logs.js instead of the default grid; the data (and this field) still exist and are unaffected.

fields.label: Prescription Link
fields.description: Our own permanent File URL (downloaded from Shukhee's short-lived presigned link once completed).

fields.label: Invoice Link
fields.description: Our own permanent File URL (downloaded from Shukhee's short-lived presigned link once completed).

fields.label: Clinical Data
fields.description: Raw `appointment.clinicalData` from Shukhee, captured once the outer `status` reaches `completed` (chiefComplaints, diagnosis, labTest, advice, drugHistory, medicine[], mealInstruction[], lastVital, followUpComment/Day/Date) -- verbatim, read-only, never edited server-side. Persisted via frappe.db.set_value, which does NOT auto-serialize JSON fields -- always json.dumps() before writing. Do NOT json.loads() after reading: Postgres/psycopg2 auto-deserializes this json-typed column back into a dict on SELECT, independent of Frappe's own ORM -- a loaded doc's .clinical_data is already a dict.

fields.label: Audit Log
fields.description: Rendered as a chronological lifecycle timeline of Shukhee Call Audit Log rows for this call -- see the sva_ft Property Setter fixture on this field (Custom HTML Block: Shukhee Call Audit Timeline).

fields.label: Sync Seq
fields.description: Stamped by spice_next_core.hooks_impl.advance_sync_seq on insert/update -- drives spice_next_core.api.sync.pull's cursor. Pull-only: Call Logs has no offline-authored push path (booking always requires a live vendor round-trip).
